integrity: Exact integer determinant, modulo-four Smith reduction, equivariant pair-module check, and eleven-case verification with attached code.
scientific_limitations: Only cubic surfaces with a Frobenius-stable six-point blow-up marking over fields of characteristic at least five; no identification with geometric Picard or Brauer torsion, and no realization theorem for every cycle type.
title: Frobenius coinvariants of the integral Schläfli double-six relation lattice
